dependency_edges.handoff: The linked report/time/location data feed the event-envelope model.
Linked Notes and labels feed LDA.
Linked and normalized images plus labels feed CNN.
The event envelope and confirmed positives feed spatial confidence.
New confirmed outcomes and accumulated negatives feed updating.
Retrained channel models return to fusion.
Confirmed positive times and spatial radius feed the monitoring gate.
Updated fit and maps feed the memorandum.
Monitoring conditions feed agency review advice.
